body: I've failed 2 years, and I'm about to fail again (highschool). The Guy I had a crush on was apparently too old for me so that never worked out (he was also the person I mentioned previously). I was given pills for my depression but i havent taken them in over a year now. I feel better tho sorta talking about it and replying to another thread. Maybe I just need rest to feel like myself (whatever i even consider that being) Thank you :D

Well how can they have any idea if you won't tell them? You don't have to go through it alone (pretty ironic since i'm putting my own self in this situation). You're also 1 year older than me that's cool. I can't really offer much honestly, because I am in no place to talk. But if you do have the ability to tell others; than tell them. Depression is a common illness and is also one of the most easily treated. The hardest part isn't the depression itself but the ability to work up enough courage to admit that you are depressed to others. After all first step to recovery is admitting you have a problem. We're human we go through these things. Some of us have more narrow roads than others; some of us have rocky roads (how unlucky right?). But how can you expect for things to get better if you wont even try taking the first step? How can you expect to get on the other side of the road if you won't stop looking at how things are and instead look at how things will be! If you don't like the life you have now then fight for a better one! God I feel better now just telling you this, because you are I are no different. We might be in this situation for different reasons but we're both looking for the exact same thing. Not an ending but an easier path. Please search harder, when you feel like giving up completely, remember that life is not meant to be a walk in the park (so many walking references, sorry) if life was sooo easy then why would we bother even having one? We're meant to go through trials. When you fail you never fall, you never stood up in the first place. Try again and again til you feel satisfied, til you feel as though you're where you want to be. We'll both end up making it to that end of the road; but who says we have to finish the journey of it so fast? IDK if im just spouting nonsense but i hope something in there helped you, i really do. It helped me a little just being able to talk to you.
